label: TP
reason: Assessed both alerts. Alert 1 (java/xss) and Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string) share the same flow: user input from request.getParameter flows through doSomething into bar, which is used as the format string in PrintWriter.printf. There is no sanitization (encoding) applied to bar before use. Attacker-controlled format string allows injection of malicious content into the HTML response, triggering XSS and format string vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: User input retrieved via getParameter, passed to doSomething, stored in map, retrieved to bar, and used in printf without sanitization.
